decisions.reason: As a newly launched product line that builds directly on the firm’s established laser-marking business, it is likely to be retained because a large, growing, R&D-active firm with organisational slack would usually give such a related offer more time unless results clearly fell below aspirations.

This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core offer and fits the firm’s single-source coding strategy, so under behavioral decision-making it would likely be kept while management learns from early market feedback rather than redeploying resources immediately.

Although somewhat more uncertain as another high-resolution inkjet variant that may face niche-demand or overlap risks, the firm’s growth, investment, and tolerance for early uncertainty make continued support more likely than withdrawal within the next year.
